title: Beetle Witch Portrait
description: A stylized portrait of a serene woman with closed eyes, her elaborate hair formed from vibrant orange and blue swirling patterns resembling snakes or curls, adorned with glowing dots. She holds a large black beetle with golden rings hovering above her palm, set against a yellow honeycomb background containing black and white vignettes of ritualistic scenes with hands, beetles, and robed figures.
prompt: Stylized surreal portrait of a calm woman with closed eyes and slight smile, her hair is a massive swirling mass of vibrant orange and blue hypnotic curls and patterns. She holds her hand out with a large black beetle hovering above it surrounded by golden rings. Yellow honeycomb background panels contain black and white scenes of ritual hands holding soil with beetles, and robed figures in a ceremony, glowing colorful dots, contemporary illustrative style with clean lines
